scope: Independent read-only source review. No app/test edits, probes, tests, GUI/GPU, package or worktree operations. qt_ci owns sole execution slot.

original_acceptance.ratio: median of nine cached per-round minima / median of nine uncached per-round minima
original_acceptance.measurement: GUI-thread CPU around synchronous backdrop.repaint(union of two viewport regions), not item-only painting or an end-to-end animation/smoothness measurement. Each _region_ms uses min12 synchronous repaints.
original_acceptance.warmup: Each cache mode gets one full region repaint before timing; cold first cache population/change-mode costs are excluded. Item cacheMode equality is asserted but cache hits/paints are not counted.
original_acceptance.context: Two2048×2048RGB images, whole real Mask window requested2560×1440, actual preferences applied and tours hidden. Timers/layout/GPU probing and warmup outside timed call can affect state but are not timed.
original_acceptance.stopping: _stop_the_field only stops backdrop._timer. It does not invoke stop/retire the shading producer. _paint_ambient checks partial paint region, declines producer.latest for a partial frame, and paints current base/frame/cards; do not infer _paint_still path from timer stopping.
original_acceptance.constraints: Do not relax0.75, time only pixmap while reporting full-field acceptance, artificially slow NoCache, inflate viewport to make the denominator expensive without a real layout reason, or claim the one passing diagnostic as acceptance.

owner_observations.scope: Already completed qt_ci diagnostic, not a probe from this reviewer and not formal acceptance.
owner_observations.paired_ratio_note: Owner reports median paired ratio equals original independent-median ratio in this diagnostic. No demonstrated paired-median cure.
owner_observations.larger_cache_note: Owner reports10→40MiB global cache experiment has no clear improvement. No cache-pressure diagnosis established.

cache_semantics: set_pixmap clears the old scene, stores the full original QPixmap in QGraphicsPixmapItem, enables DeviceCoordinateCache, sets original-pixel sceneRect, resets user zoom and fits. Device caching does not reduce exported picture resolution.

Qt device cache stores rendering in device coordinates and regenerates after direct/indirect transform changes. Fit/resize/wheel zoom and peer transform invalidate appropriately; pan behavior is managed by Qt, not an explicit full-image rescale in Python paintEvent.

Original scene pixels remain hover/ruler coordinate system; paintEvent first calls QGraphicsView paint, then draws the ruler only if a start exists. Ruler state/invalidation remains independent of pixmap cache.
A cached item may be evicted and legitimately repaint; cacheMode alone is not evidence of a persistent hit. Need actual paint counts/state from owning diagnostic before asserting eviction.

At fittedscale0.28418, a2048square occupies about582square pixels inside a1221×586viewport. Transparent letterboxing occupies much of region; original image memory is not the same as the device cache footprint. A rough32bpp two-picture cache is~2.6MiB atDPR1, before Qt padding/other entries; this estimate does not prove allocation/hit behavior. DPR2/more canvases can exceed10MiB.

fixed_cost_analysis.finding: Empty-field median0.7696ms is large relative to~1ms totals. Genuine saved scaling can coexist with an inadequate25% whole-region saving. Common overhead includes field base/frame/cards, QWidget backing-store/transparent ancestors and graphics viewport/scene traversal, not merely QGraphicsPixmapItem.paint.
fixed_cost_analysis.limit: The empty diagnostic follows original alternating rounds and changes visibility, so subtracting medians is explanatory, not a replacement acceptance metric. Do not report a derived image-only ratio as the original test result.
fixed_cost_analysis.paint_path: Ambient _paint_ambient already has a composed Source drawImage path when producer/card-plan/origin match; otherwise it paints base plus smooth scaled image and optional cards. Determine which actual path runs before adding a redundant cache.
awaited_owner_evidence: Actual per-round item paint counts and cache regeneration
Active Mask panel ownership and settled geometry
Backdrop engine type, frame size, producer/card-composition status and current plan/origin

concrete_optimization_candidates.candidate: Reduce genuine common field-presentation cost for repeated same-frame partial exposes.
concrete_optimization_candidates.seam: Ambient._paint_ambient/_paint_base plus _BufferedEngine.blit, only after owner establishes classic versus already-composed route.
concrete_optimization_candidates.mechanism: A bounded widget-owned presentation-size composition of unchanged base/frame/cards could avoid repeated smooth upscale/composition while transparent children repaint; the existing composed path may already provide this. An exact clipped Source draw of an already-composed frame may be enough.
concrete_optimization_candidates.proof_required: Actual reduced empty/cached total cost with untouched original test and honest NoCache reference; full pixel parity, proper theme/frame/size/DPR/wallpaper-origin/card-plan invalidation, worker ownership and bounded replacement buffers. No claim of measured gain in this audit.

concrete_optimization_candidates.candidate: Maintain effective device cache at real viewport/DPR and cache pressure.
concrete_optimization_candidates.mechanism: Observe regeneration before considering a bounded size-aware budget or local presentation cache. Raising global cache alone is not supported by current diagnostic.
concrete_optimization_candidates.proof_required: Item paint/hit counts, pressure/high-DPR/resize behavior and original pixel/zoom/export parity; no synthetic NoCache slowdown.

concrete_optimization_candidates.candidate: Reduce graphics-view bookkeeping only if profile attributes meaningful common cost.
concrete_optimization_candidates.seam: QGraphicsView painter state, scene indexing and exposed-region computation.
concrete_optimization_candidates.mechanism: One-item scene may benefit from appropriate flags, but removing painter-state protection/antialias expansion can cause artifacts or leak state.
concrete_optimization_candidates.proof_required: Do not enable optimization flags by assumption. Validate item/message/ruler paint state, edges and full viewport hashes; expected gain remains unmeasured.

preserve_behavior: Original QPixmap resolution/bytes for PNG/PDF export and dynamic picture name
Scene pixel geometry and no letterbox hover/ruler measurement
Cursor-anchored zoom, peer transform/pan synchronization, fit-to-load/resize semantics
Shared ruler on source/mask views, right-click clearing versus save menu and ruler overlay redraw
Transparent letterbox backdrop/theme/card/chrome visuals and cached/uncached pixel equality
show_message clears old picture and cannot export stale image
New field/image cache replacement and bounds at HiDPI/zoom/resize; no ever-growing cache

official_sources.supports: Device-coordinate cache regenerates after transforms; cache behavior/quality differ from item-coordinate cache.
Default10MiB, main-thread use and least-recently-accessed eviction when space is needed.
Painter-state and antialias-region flags carry correctness assumptions; avoid blind changes.
